The Alethia story

Get support on
your own terms.

Most aid systems ask vulnerable people to trade privacy for access. Alethia changes the exchange. Your evidence stays encrypted on your device while a zero-knowledge proof confirms only what a program needs to know.

No public identity. No visible documents. No permanent trail of your circumstances.

Truth, gently revealed.

The proof desk

It’s okay to stop and
ask for directions.

Privacy technology can feel complicated. Alethia reduces it to one promise: prove what matters, protect everything else.

Talk to a program guide →
◉

What does Alethia store?

Your program receipt and public proof status. Sensitive documents remain encrypted in your private state, not on a public ledger.

⌁

Can claims be linked?

No public profile is required. Program-specific nullifiers stop repeat claims without creating a reusable identifier across programs.

✦

Who sees my evidence?

You decide. A verifier receives only the fact the policy requests, such as “eligible,” never the documents used to prove it.

↻

What if I’m offline?

Field workers can prepare an encrypted claim locally. The proof submits when connectivity returns, preserving the original record.
